completed_outcomes.outcome: CommanderSpineBasisFields now pins to the BLOB OID of skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json (not repo HEAD), and FAILs (never skips) on drift, with the re-verify command printed inline in the failure message. Both directions of the granularity fix proven with an isolated-clone mutation battery: a planted template edit fails all 3 protected tests, an unrelated commit leaves them green.

wave_evidence.expected: An unrelated commit elsewhere in the repo must leave the tests GREEN; a template edit must turn them RED.

wave_evidence.observed: The re-verify path is exactly `git rev-parse HEAD:skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json`, printed verbatim in the fail message; no new script or tooling introduced.

discrepancies.signal: The plan-critic's finding 1 (concurrent-lane race: w3-promote owns edits to the exact file this pin keys off) said to recompute PINNED_BLOB as the LAST implementation step, immediately before g1-integrate. The implementer instead set a real value early (needed for the mutation-battery clones to have a correct pin to test against) and re-verified it unchanged immediately before returning, rather than deferring the write itself to the very end.
discrepancies.affects: Handoff wording precision for future clone-based mutation-battery gates
discrepancies.reason: The intent (ship a pin that reflects the template's actual current content, not a stale dispatch-time snapshot) was satisfied either way — re-verification confirmed no drift occurred between the two checks, and this Commander independently re-confirmed PINNED_BLOB against a fresh git rev-parse before accepting g1-implement. Not a defect in this run's outcome, but a precision gap in the plan's own wording ('computed last' vs. 'recomputed and reconfirmed last') worth tightening in a future handoff for a similarly clone-based proof.
